evidence.observation: 3.3 ppm at growth start, consistent with the 2-6 ppm seen during the ramp
Rose steadily to 33.2 ppm (6.3, 10.7, 17.1, 22.2, 26.2, 33.2) during growth
Pressure steady at about 760 Torr, so an exhaust blockage is unlikely
Ar flow tracks the 100 sccm setpoint, so a stuck MFC is unlikely
Temperature holds 750 °C and heater power is steady at about 46%
